comment: VERSION 3 — adds site_text_patch (writable-paths v4 textPatch block): governed single-line text-surface replacement over the surface catalogue, one publication_approval stage, same authenticated decision surface as the phone patch. VERSION 2 — public_hours_patch removed. governance/writable-paths.v1.json documentedOperations.public_hours_patch withdrew this operation kind's write authority in version 1; it remained buildable and approvable here through version 1, which meant an approver could be asked to sign off a candidate that was already dead on arrival at the write gate. Removing the operations[] entry means a public_hours_patch candidate now fails structural approval-policy lookup, not only the final write. See governance/evidence/2026-08-20-phone-and-hours-audit.v1.md, finding 2.
